title: The True Heroes' Council
text: Well then, it’s time for the Heroes’ Council.
“Well then, I’ll be off.”
“It was quite lively over at the bathhouse, wasn’t it?”
The hermit asked with a smile.
“Indeed. I declared I was there to peep and ended up in a bit of a back-and-forth with the Big Sisters.”
“It sounds like there was quite a lively exchange. Come to think of it, the Spear Hero was made to sit seiza-style. Were your legs all right?”
“I’m fine. I was just fulfilling my duty as a man. Getting scolded is all part of the deal.”
“The Spear Hero is a very free-spirited sort of person, you know.”
“Has Yuki’s charm gone up? Motoyasu-sama!”
“It’s perfect. But showing her back isn’t the only thing that makes her charming.”
“Then it must be her legs, then.”
Hmm… I suppose because she grew up in a different environment than the Yuki-chan I know, her perspective is a bit different.
“I didn’t see it like that.”
“Ho ho ho.”
“Well then, I’m off to the meeting of the heroes. It’s a discussion on how to make the world a better place.”
“Have a safe trip.”
And so, seeing me off by Yuki-chan and the sages, I was guided by Kagebuta to the conference room at the hotel.
“Sorry about that! I’m running late!”
When I arrived at the conference room, my fathers were already waiting, on the edge of their seats. We took our seats around the circular table.
“Bububu… Bubuhi, Bubububu”

It seems Kagebuta is acting as the moderator. By the way, since this is taking a little longer than in the first world, this meeting is happening after the island bosses have started appearing. As for the rest… well, we aren’t equipped with the accessory—the event item used for making wishes—from the first world.
“Now then, let’s get this meeting started… Ren and Itsuki, is there anything you’d like to say first?”
Huh? Does that mean I won’t get a chance to speak? No, Father is a thoughtful man. He’s surely just trying to sound out Ren and Itsuki.
“Hmph…”
“Isn’t that the whole point of this meeting?”
“I see… So, why weren’t you two punished for eavesdropping?”
“We just didn’t do anything stupid.”
“It was unnecessary, after all.”
“I see… What a coincidence. If only you’d responded like that when you were acting normally.”
“By the way, we got along just fine in the first world.”
My father is staring intently at me. Staring at me like that makes me feel self-conscious.
“Bubuhi! Buu-buu!”
Shadow Pig is saying something. Probably his thoughts on each of us.

“Thoughts on our comrades, huh… Ren, since your comrades are just ordinary folks, I think you should stick to the public battle front instead of trying to recruit them. Save your secret side for Black Thunder.”
“I see… Hmph, I’ll do my best.”
My father is getting better at handling Ren!

“Hmph… As for my thoughts, regarding the <PHANTOM Warrior> named Raphtalia, she should tone down her presence a bit more and focus on a fighting style where she slays enemies at every opportunity. The Phantom Sword truly has something special about it. As for Sadeena… she’d be perfect if she weren’t a Beastman. As for Filo… don’t put her in battle; let her live peacefully in the outside world.”
My father, with a somber air about him, is listening to Ren’s impressions of his Big Sister.
“My Big Sister’s Big Sister… Sadeena also has a Demi-Human form. She’s quite the beauty.”
Since she usually goofs around in her Beastman form, Ren probably didn’t know that.
“I see… Then it would be better to make that her usual form. Have her transform only when using her finishing move.”
“I don’t really understand why you’re giving such detailed instructions… Sigh… Since I’ve already warned her, I’ll give Sadeena some advice. Whether she follows it is another matter, though.”
“Hmph… Fine.”
It’s acting coaching for Ren. What a hassle.
“Now, as for Itsuki… Telling him probably won’t solve anything.”
“Is there something wrong with me?”
“No… I’m sure you get along well with that guy Fleon, but it’s just that you should listen to what the others have to say, too.”
“Sigh… I’ll take it as a suggestion.”
Itsuki nodded impassively, looking as though he didn’t quite grasp Father’s advice. Considering the previous loop, at least he’s willing to listen now.

“As for my opinion… it’s generally similar to Ren-san’s. I think Raphtalia has a talent for moving without drawing attention, so it’d be good to develop that. As for Sadeena, I like how she’s carefree on the surface but actually hides her true strength.”
“What about Filo?”
“I think if she teams up with Melty, she’ll shine as a champion of justice.”
At Itsuki’s words, his Father reacted with a sigh. It seems he has some thoughts on the matter.
“It’s true those two get along well… but she is, after all, a princess of a nation… No, wait—that kind of heroine does exist in those circles. In that sense, is it a classic trope?”
Well, it seems Father is showing a certain degree of understanding. I suppose this is because he still has memories of Earth.
“As for Motoyasu, I haven’t really been involved with him, so what do you two—Ren and Itsuki—think?”
“Huh… He said you were the one who introduced him to the ‘Jet-Black Claws.’ I’m grateful.”
“Thank you for introducing me to Ms. Fleon, that important flying Filolial. Thanks to her, I was able to bring the evil within my own family to justice.”

“…So the one who goes by Yuki hasn’t even crossed your radar, huh? I suppose everyone will discuss their own plans from here on out… but given the changes you’ve all undergone, I doubt my advice will be of much use.”
My father sighed, rested both elbows on the table, and looked at me.

“I imagine you’ve heard a bit about Kage as well, but it seems Motoyasu ended up like this because memories of the future came to him. Because of that, he’s been working behind the scenes, providing us with power—or rather, all sorts of information. Like Black Thunder and Fleon.”
“Bub, bubbub… oink.”
Kage-buta nodded slightly and replied to my Father.
“Well, even with knowledge of the future, some events turn out differently, so it’s not perfect. Just like that princess who died because of her own actions.”
At this point, my Father emphasized the Crimson Swine’s fate. It was something I did, but… since my Father is looking at me as if to say, “Don’t say anything unnecessary,” I’ll just keep quiet.
“B… Bubb.”
“Ah, the Queen also said that if there’s a next time, we should prevent that foolish daughter from destroying herself and make her face her own sins.”
“That’s impossible. She survived once before, but she didn’t reflect on her actions at all. Besides, her true identity is the pawn causing these waves.”
By the way, my Father did understand that he couldn’t understand pig language.
“Oink!?”
Kagebuta let out a startled cry at that moment.
“A princess who belonged to the forces of darkness was trying to sow discord among the heroes… I see.”
“She was a suspicious character, so it was only natural she got what was coming to her. That princess, too, was likely evil masquerading as justice.”
Ren and Itsuki accepted this without a second thought.
“Oink-oink! Oink-oink!”
He’s probably asking for more details.
“Motoyasu, just give us the gist of it—break it down so we can understand.”
“Well… apparently, the goddess who posed as a god—the root cause of all this turmoil—reincarnated a part of her own soul and sent it to this world, and that being looks like a Crimson Swine.”
“‘Crimson Swine’ means ‘Bitch.’ You should figure that out for yourself. I believed her, but apparently she was put through hell in some future timeline.”
“B-Boo…”

My father is speaking to Shadow Pig in a rather confrontational tone. After all, there’s absolutely no way I can defend Crimson Swine. What I can’t do, I just can’t do. The only thing I can do to the Crimson Swine is exploit her as much as possible and then kill her in the most gruesome way. It’s that classic scenario where you think you’re using someone, only to find out you’re the one being used. The proper way to handle a pig that’s been sucking up the good life is to slaughter it and ship it off. Which would give me more satisfaction: shipping her off to the Pig King, or making her suffer and die from poison? The crime of killing Fleon-chan can’t be atoned for by just dying once.

“Motoyasu did offer what you might call mercy—or a reprieve—but that guy blew himself up with a secret stash of poison he’d snagged from who-knows-where… You know that, right? And since the guy who came from another future says there’s no salvation, I guess it just can’t be done.”

That’s Father’s response to the Queen’s proposal, laced with his own brand of evasion. It’s true that the decision rests solely with me, so the Crimson Swine’s survival is impossible. After all, despite everything, the Queen cares deeply for her family, just like Trash. While that’s certainly a virtue, it’s unnecessary when dealing with the Crimson Swine. In fact, the Queen died precisely because of that mercy.
“Let’s get back to the topic at hand. Ren and Itsuki, you both said these were game worlds you were familiar with—what do you think of them now?”
In response to Father’s question, Ren is still sporting that defiant smile.

“Under the guidance of the Jet-Black Claws, even I—who’ve come to know the darkness—was able to figure it out. It’s a world governed by a different set of rules—the Akashic Rules—that incorporates elements similar to Brave Star Online.”
“…So you figured it out after getting captured by Black Thunder and getting your ass kicked a bunch, is that it? I hear Motoyasu strengthened him quite a bit.”

After all, I strengthened Black Thunder enough to capture Ren alive. Of course, I taught Black Thunder how to get stronger, and I even wrote it down on paper to make it easier to understand. I wrote it up in a notebook-style format, complete with those cryptic, difficult ruby annotations that Black Thunder used to spout, and laid out all the various ways to get stronger.

“I was saved by Fleon from the evil lurking within justice… At first, I didn’t trust him, but after hearing my comrades’ true feelings and believing in the teachings that stem from Fleon’s strength, I came to understand many things.”
As always, Itsuki speaks with that wooden accent of his.
“So, aside from the brainwashing sound waves, you changed your mind after hearing your comrades’ true feelings… Either way, it seems Motoyasu’s message got through to you just fine.”
It’s surprising even to me—it looks like both of them are actually putting the strengthening methods into practice.

“So, Motoyasu, according to what you said, besides the enhancement of the Four Holy Weapons, there’s also the enhancement of the so-called Seven Star Weapons, right? I’ve already used some of them, but I’d like to hear about them again… Is that okay?”
“Indeed. Both Ren and Itsuki understand that this includes their own enhancement as well, don’t they?”

In response to my question, Ren flashed a cynical smile, while Itsuki simply nodded obediently. Everything’s going so smoothly. It seems Ren and Itsuki were being stubborn precisely because Filolial-sama wasn’t present.

Hmm? I feel like I’ve been shaking my head repeatedly, thinking that the Ren in my memories—from the first world and the world we headed to Faubrey—is different… but I’m definitely not mistaken! Similarly, Itsuki is staring at me with a blank expression. The one reacting the same way as Ren is Itsuki from the world we headed to Faubrey. Aren’t their personalities overlapping a bit?
“Looks like we’re on the same page… Well then, let’s proceed by deciphering Motoyasu’s notes while enhancing our weapons.”
“Got it!”

And so, the meeting between the heroes—including my Father and the others—proceeded without a hitch. After reviewing the final list of enhancements we’d compiled, my Father remarked that the enhancement system was quite complex. But the more enhancements you apply, the stronger you’ll become!

Anyway, I was able to teach Ren and Itsuki the enhancement methods surprisingly smoothly. Even those stubborn Ren and Itsuki! Since you have to strike while the iron is hot—or else they’ll get stubborn—being able to persuade them like this is a huge win. From now on, if I end up in a loop midway through, I’ll ask Fleon-chan and Black Thunder for help! That’s what I’ve decided.
A few days later… it’s just before the scheduled end date of our hunting trip on Cal Mira Island.

“Well then… I’m really going to miss you all, but I’ve got to step out for a bit on some business. Yuki-chan, please take care of training the other Filolial-sama just as I asked. If anything happens, ask your Father for help.”
“Motoyasu-sama, are you really leaving!? Yuki will miss you so much!”

Yuki-chan clings to my arm, looking as if she’s going to be left behind. This Yuki-chan is especially clingy, even compared to the Yuki-chans I’ve known before. Even though she looks almost like an adult, she’s actually more prone to feeling lonely than the childish Yuki-chan.
“By ‘Father,’ you mean Mr. Naofumi, don’t you? He’s the one who remains completely unfazed by Lord Motoyasu’s affection!”
“Yuki-chan. I’ve caused my Father an immense amount of trouble. That’s precisely why I must make amends. Above all, if it weren’t for my Father, I would never have met Yuki-chan in the first place.”

That’s right. My Father raised Filo-tan, corrected my mistakes, and encouraged me when I was down. That’s when my true love began. If I hadn’t awakened to true love, I probably wouldn’t have met Yuki-chan and the others either. I owe it all to my Father and Filo-tan.
“I apologize for that. But Motoyasu-sama, how do you feel about Naofumi-san?”
“He’s someone I must devote myself to no matter what. That’s how deeply grateful I am to him.”
